scope: Personal base coverage: two selected sources in each of three assigned directions; all component conditions retained.

authority.question_translation: Under the component scopes and retained conditions in the review table, confirm ReasoningBank + ExpeL, AgentRewind + StateFork, and AgentScope + AgentDojo as the personal foundation of two sources in each of three directions?
authority.answer_translation: Conditionally admit within the scope of the table.
authority.provenance: Translated from the existing local authority record and review table; original records retained locally. This repository summary does not claim a new human review.

decisions.scope: Retrieval, inference-based experience extraction, JSONL append and embedding cache (RB1-RB4); RB5 remains paper system support, not an independent mechanism.
retained_conditions: Update only from permitted train evidence; freeze before dev/test.
Judge and embedding costs and local gains remain unmeasured.
Using a pretrained embedding model is not parameter fitting; no whole-dependency guarantee.

decisions.scope: Text-rule/count maintenance, retrieval and prompt construction (EX1-EX2); EX3 concerns reflection-based experience collection and its cost, not weight training.
retained_conditions: Preserve paper/code operation differences and unknown complete Reflexion dependencies.
Do not omit experience-collection costs or use sealed evaluation feedback to update rules.

decisions.scope: Context reconstruction, recording/Git workspace restoration and external-side-effect boundaries (AR1-AR3).
retained_conditions: Git rollback does not restore external APIs, databases or processes.
Do not reset cumulative tokens, time or cost on recovery.
Do not adopt repeated hidden-acceptance feedback from the original setup as the project protocol.

decisions.scope: Logical restoration, fixed-threshold decisions, system snapshots and backend conditions (SF1-SF4); no task-specific neural training is selected.
retained_conditions: Physical-backend and operating-system operability remain unknown.
Successful replay return does not establish equivalent observations.
Do not generalize concurrent physical fork support to all virtual-node behavior.

decisions.scope: Hook registries, asynchronous wrapping, pre/post order and replacement contracts (AS1-AS3).
retained_conditions: Callbacks can execute arbitrary code; the interface does not guarantee that every extension is training-free.
Normal post is not guaranteed exception cleanup.
Side effects, ordering and actual cost require separate verification.

decisions.scope: Five-tuple state threading, sequential composition and tool-output formatting (AD1-AD3); specific trainable detectors are excluded.
retained_conditions: Elements can have arbitrary side effects; no universal finally or physical-recovery guarantee.
Native max_iters=15 is a source default and has not been adopted as a project limit.
